appraisal_events.evidence: il plongea un regard attentif, sérieux, absorbé, presque soucieux, dans les profondeurs du corsage, et ses narines... palpitèrent comme un papillon prêt à aller se poser sur la fleur entrevue; explained by 'une vie déjà avancée' having eroded either his moral will or his physical power to conceal desire.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator directly frames Swann's absorbed, barely-concealed ogling of Mme de Surgis as a sign of age- or illness-weakened self-command, presenting him in an undignified, declining light.

appraisal_events.evidence: Un démon de perversité l'avait poussée... à vivre de la façon la plus scandaleuse... depuis dix ans, personne, sauf de rares amies fidèles, ne la saluait plus; elle avait mal calculé en le choisissant comme amant... Mme de Surgis redescendrait pour la deuxième fois cette pente qu'elle avait eu tant de peine à remonter.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator recounts Mme de Surgis's scandalous past and years of social exile, and predicts that her attempt to reclaim standing through her affair with Basin will fail again once the duchesse de Guermantes's circle turns against her.

status_effects.explanation: Swann's absorbed, undisguised staring into Mme de Surgis's bosom, glossed by the narrator as age-weakened self-control, casts him in an unflattering, undignified light.
Her scandalous past and near-total social ostracism are recalled, and her present attempt to reclaim standing through Basin is framed as poised to fail again, weakening her local position.
The narrator's characterization of a 'démon de perversité' driving her to live scandalously casts her personal conduct negatively.
